summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe 1.115.3 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs (with `_0x`-style obfuscated identifiers) selects a platform-specific Bun binary, downloads it from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), unpacks to a temp dir, chmods 0755, and then executes `bun math_init.js` from the package root via `execFileSync`. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-only bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) using string-array rotation obfuscation (WV8StW rotator, large hex/int constant table, `_0x`-prefixed identifiers), and its runtime behavior is not observable without executing the Bun bytecode. The legitimate library surface in `dist/` (React portal-store using mobx and cp-ui/react-ioc, browser-only) has no build or runtime need for a separate Bun interpreter, and fetching an alternate runtime purely to execute a sibling obfuscated payload evades Node-only inspection and yields full host code execution on any machine that runs `npm install` against this version. The shape is consistent with a compromised-publisher injection into an otherwise legitimate @servicetitan package: the added preinstall + setup.mjs + math_init.js are the harmful surface, alongside intact library code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
